language.label: Language
language.description: The language Atlarix replies in. Code, file paths and commands stay as they are. Follows your system language unless you choose one.

peerMessages.label: Messages from other sessions
peerMessages.description: Lets another Atlarix session on this computer (the app or the CLI) send this one a message, which it answers. Nothing leaves your computer. Off: they are refused.

sessionRecap.label: Session recap
sessionRecap.description: When you come back to a chat after a few minutes away, a one-line recap of where it stands. Written by the chat's own model; never saved or sent back to it. Shared with the CLI and editors.

foundMcp.title: Found on this computer
foundMcp.detail: Servers you set up in other tools. Add one to use it here, in the CLI and in your editor.

providers.apiFormatAnthropicDescription: An endpoint that speaks the Anthropic Messages API.

mcp.upTo: Up to {{max}} on at a time.
mcp.emptyLocal: Nothing on this computer for this folder yet.
mcp.removeAccountBody: Atlarix stops using it on all your devices, and any sign-in you gave it is deleted. You can add it again later.
mcp.pastePlaceholder: Paste a URL, a command, or an mcpServers config

activity.title: Your activity
activity.description: How you use Atlarix on this computer, across the app, CLI and editors
activity.empty: Nothing yet. Your first chat starts the count.
activity.footnoteSince: Stored only on this computer. Tokens, models, skills and MCP servers count from {{day}}.
activity.footnoteNext: Stored only on this computer. Tokens, models, skills and MCP servers count from your next chat.

byokDefault.detail: Your key is saved, but new chats still use Atlarix Auto until you change the model.
byokDefault.willUse: New chats would use {{model}}. Change it any time from the model picker.

computerUse.label: Computer use
computerUse.description: A model you switch on can see your screen and use the mouse and keyboard. It works on whatever is open, so close what you don't want it to touch. Move the mouse to take control back.
computerUse.restartHint: Allowed it in System Settings? Restart to apply.
